items.title: GTA 6 is 30 FPS, even on the Pro
items.note: Rockstar confirmed a 30 FPS target on every console, and PS5 Pro owners are not happy. Trending worldwide and in KSA.
items.read: Gaming account Wario64 posted that Grand Theft Auto VI is targeting 30 FPS, with PSSR and ray-traced shadows supported on PS5 Pro, plus Xbox Cloud Gaming and remote play on PS5 and Xbox. The post links to Rockstar's official pre-load announcement and includes a screenshot of the details. Rockstar has confirmed the same 30 FPS target on every current-generation console, with no 40 or 60 FPS performance mode mentioned. Within a few hours the post had about 1.24 million views and nearly 7,000 likes.

items.title: “You bought a Pro… for 30 FPS”
items.note: The Arabic take on the same joke.
items.read: Saudi gaming account Crawz (@IREDN1) posted in Arabic asking how people who bought a PS5 Pro just for GTA 6 must feel, now that it is 30 frames. Two photos accompany the joke, which riffs on Rockstar's 10 November confirmation that the game targets 30 FPS on every console, including the Pro. The Pro still gets visual extras such as PSSR and ray-traced shadows, but not a higher frame-rate mode. A few hours after posting, the tweet had about 10,200 views and 225 likes.

items.title: Most pre-ordered game in PlayStation Store history
items.note: GTA VI pre-load is live nine days before the 19 Nov launch.
items.read: The official PlayStation account said Grand Theft Auto VI is the most pre-ordered game in PlayStation Store history. The post tells players to clear PS5 storage and start pre-loading today, ahead of the 19 November launch, and includes a roughly 49-second video on why the game "plays best on PS5". Sony's PlayStation Blog repeats the record claim and says pre-loading opened nine days early because of demand, with a rolling midnight launch starting at 12:00 AM NZDT in New Zealand on 19 November. The post had about 871,000 views and more than 28,000 likes.

items.title: Clear DualSense controllers
items.note: PlayStation's see-through Prism Collection, pre-orders open today.
items.read: PlayStation's official account said pre-orders are live today for transparent DualSense controllers in the Prism Collection, which arrives on 4 February, and posted four photos with orange, green and gray heart emojis for the colorways. Sony's blog names the colors Flare Orange, Emerald Green and Graphite Gray. The recommended retail price is $84.99, £74.99 or €84.99 for a controller and $74.99, £64.99 or €74.99 for matching PS5 console covers, with a launch date of 4 February 2027. Pre-orders opened on 10 November 2026.
facts: Flare Orange, Emerald Green, Graphite Gray

items.title: AI Haaland frees the candy… with scissors
items.note: AI parody: Bellingham brings a saw, Yamal a hammer, Haaland wins with scissors. About 12M views in 17 hours, on Saudi YouTube's chart.
items.read: This 21-second YouTube Short from ainimal-rescue-ai is an AI-generated 3D parody, not real footage of the footballers. Animated Mbappé tries to free a blue candy stuck in a soda can; Bellingham arrives with a hand saw and Yamal with a hammer, which only wrecks the can, before Haaland gets it out with scissors. There is no dialogue, only music and sound effects. It was published on 9 November 2026 and was reported at about 12.3 million views within 17 hours.
facts: about 12.3 million in under a day

items.title: Cadel dodges the kick, then sees the battleaxe
items.note: An 11-second gag for 32M subscribers, at about 6.7M views.
items.read: YouTube channel Cadel and Mia posted a short, dialogue-free sketch whose title celebrates reaching 32 million subscribers. Cadel jumps over Mia's sweeping kick and lands cleanly, then puts on his glasses, looks back and sees she is holding a large double-bladed battleaxe. Mia adds a playful warning gesture before walking away down a hallway. The video was published on 9 November 2026 and was reported at about 6.7 million views within 18 hours.

items.title: “I'm Graham”
items.note: Viva La Dirt League's customer who keeps saying his name at checkout. No. 1 in several countries.
items.read: In this Viva La Dirt League sketch, a TechTown cashier totals a purchase at $389, and a customer named Graham insists the figure is wrong and that saying "I'm Graham" should be enough. The cashier offers a loyalty-program lookup and asks for a last name; Graham refuses, asks whether manager Rowan has mentioned him, and grows more indignant when he is still not recognized. Rowan then rushes out of the back office, distraught that "Graham just disowned me," which only confuses the cashier further. On YouTube the video is titled "I think we're seeing a glimpse of future Ben..."
facts: I think we're seeing a glimpse of future Ben...

items.title: Floor is lava, chair pogo edition
items.note: Bob Reese bounces the last stretch on a folding chair.
items.read: Creator Bob Reese's first-person Short "FLOOR IS LAVA" follows him through a gym without touching the floor. He skips the foam pit in case it counts as the floor, jumps to a high bar, edges along a skinny wall, then hops the last stretch on a folding chair used like a pogo stick. He tries to swing to a hanging paper finish sign, but it does not hold his weight. The video was published on 9 November 2026 and was reported at just over a million views after about a day.
facts: about 1.07 million after about a day

items.title: Rain in Buraidah
items.note: A Buraidah local shares the rain and cool air as winter rolls in, tagged #بريدة #القصيم.
items.read: Qassim-based account Mohamed Al-Budairi (@m_koraiss) posted a photo from Buraidah with a caption saying the city "is different today," describing rain and pleasant weather and praying that it be rains of goodness and blessing. The post is tagged #بريدة and #القصيم. It went up in the early afternoon on 10 November 2026, Asia/Riyadh time, and had a modest audience of about 1,700 views. It is a local weather snapshot rather than an official forecast.

items.title: Pocky Day and Pepero Day
items.note: It's already 11 Nov in East Asia, so the stick-snack holiday is trending worldwide.
items.read: The Korea Times, in a 9 November 2026 guide, explains Pepero Day, the informal Korean holiday on 11 November when people exchange thin chocolate-coated biscuit sticks. Lotte Wellfood launched Pepero in 1983, and the custom is often traced to 1990s middle-school students in Yeongnam wishing one another would "grow tall and slender." Convenience chains CU, GS25, 7-Eleven and Emart24 sell boxes for 1,500 to 2,000 won (about $1.10 to $1.50), including original chocolate, almond, an uncoated hollow wafer and cookies-and-cream, plus seasonal flavors such as matcha and peanut butter. Seoul bakeries also make artisan versions, including Pepero-style financiers at Soso Baking in Seongsu-dong and chocolate-coated sablé "Pabli" at Chagok Patisserie in Yeonnam-dong.

items.title: The Groves, Hizam Park
items.note: Riyadh Season zone opened 9 Nov: restaurants, a lakefront stage and outdoor winter dining.
items.read: What's On Saudi Arabia reports that The Groves 2026, a Riyadh Season outdoor dining and entertainment zone, opened on Monday 9 November in Hizam Park, Ar Rafiah. Chapter V is organized as five subzones — The Groves Village, The Groves Pizzeria, Al Jalsa, The Lakefront and Luca Park — plus five restaurants, including Greek Opa Kefi, Turkish Anne Oja and the lakefront Zodiac Garden, and six staged experiences such as Charlie Chonka's carnival and nightly Greek-wedding shows. The Lakefront has a giant screen for sports, concerts and other live entertainment, and Luca Park is described as Saudi Arabia's first dog park, with indoor and outdoor areas. Hours are 4pm to midnight Saturday to Wednesday and 4pm to 1am Thursday and Friday, with tickets starting at SAR 48.

items.title: NOIR Café, VIA Riyadh
items.note: The Qatari café's second Riyadh branch, open 5pm to 1am.
items.read: NOIR Café's own reservations page presents VIA Riyadh as a new branch for its artisanal pastries, specialty coffee and formal café setting, inside the open-air VIA complex. It is at Entrance V8 and is open from 5pm to 1am. The listed phone number is +966 11 511 5747. The same site already describes a Riyadh location at Laysen Valley and lists Qatar alongside Saudi Arabia among its markets.

items.title: Riyadh Cat Show and Dog Village
items.note: Saudi Pet & Vet Expo, today through 11 Nov at the Riyadh International Convention and Exhibition Center, 3pm to 10pm.
items.read: The official Cat Show visitor page for the fifth Saudi Pet & Vet Expo says visitors pick one day — 9, 10 or 11 November 2026 — from 3pm to 10pm. A visitor ticket costs SAR 75 including 15% VAT and admits only the Cat Show, not Dog Village; the wider expo is free with online registration. Children under 10 are not allowed into the Cat Show or the expo, children 10 and over need a paying adult with a separate ticket, and pets are not allowed in the Cat Show or expo halls. Dog Village, organized by Pawdi at the same venue, the Riyadh International Convention and Exhibition Center on King Abdullah Road, has its own visitor tickets from SAR 65 and competitions such as Best Trick, Sit & Stay and Best Dressed.
facts: Riyadh International Convention and Exhibition Center, King Abdullah Road

items.title: AlDirah Winter, historic Ad Dirah
items.note: New heritage zone with Najdi markets and Samri nights. Free entry, open until 9 Mar 2027.
items.read: The Riyadh Atlas reports that AlDirah Winter opened on 1 November 2026 as an official Riyadh Season zone in the historic Ad Dirah district and runs until 9 March 2027, a 128-day programme organized by AlDirah Development Company. Activities are spread across seven areas, including Samri evenings and auctions at Al Moaiqliah Plaza, heritage markets at Al Qaisariah Plaza, storytelling at AlDirah Majlis, comedy and competitions on AlDirah Stage, and family workshops in AlDirah Park. The district sits near Al Masmak Palace in the old trading centre. General admission is free, though some experiences need complimentary Webook tickets, and the zone operates daily from 5pm to 11pm.
facts: free; some areas need complimentary Webook tickets

items.title: COP31, Antalya
items.note: UN climate conference through 20 Nov. The public Green Zone usually runs 9am to 10pm, but it's closed 11 to 12 Nov and opens at noon on 9 and 15 Nov.
items.read: COP31, the 31st UN climate conference, is being hosted by Türkiye in Antalya from 9 to 20 November 2026, at the Antalya EXPO Center in Aksu. The Blue Zone is limited to accredited delegates, while the public Green Zone is the open exhibition, talks, workshops and evening events area; entry is generally free but advance registration is required. Official Green Zone hours are usually 9am to 10pm Antalya time (GMT+3), but it opens at noon on 9 and 15 November, and it is closed to visitors on 11 and 12 November for the Leaders Summit. Thematic hubs close at 18:00 every day. The campus also includes pavilions, amphitheatre concerts, a Start Up Zone and, organizers say, more than 1,000 artworks across a 1.1-million-square-metre site.

items.title: Miniatur Wunderland Rainforest, Hamburg
items.note: A new 175 m² South America world opened 9 Nov after almost four years of work.
items.read: Miniatur Wunderland in Hamburg opened its new section "Regenwald – Amazonas, Anden und Atacama" on Monday 9 November 2026, after almost four years of work, 180,000 labour hours and about six million euros in construction costs. The 175-square-metre South America layout was inaugurated with Hamburg mayor Peter Tschentscher placing the last of 30,000 handmade trees. Highlights include Iguazú Falls with about 20,000 litres of real water an hour and a small rainbow in the mist, night-time fireflies, 13,000 miniature figures, 240 trains and 33 visitor-activated button sequences. The model also shows threats to the rainforest, such as deforestation, fires and illegal gold mines, and rises from the Amazon basin to the Andes and the Atacama Desert.

items.title: GTA VI Vice City pop-up, Selfridges London
items.note: Exclusive merch and a custom £1M Grotti supercar, 9 to 28 Nov.
items.read: Selfridges is running a Grand Theft Auto VI pop-up at The Corner Shop in its London store from 9 to 28 November, timed to the game's 19 November launch in Vice City, Leonida. The takeover includes exclusive fashion collaborations and limited-edition merch such as Vice City sports jerseys, Burger Shot apparel, I Heart VC tees and a Members Only jacket. A custom pink-and-blue Grotti Cheetah, built with West Coast Customs, is offered for £1 million through Selfridges Personal Shopping. Some items sold out online but were still listed as available in London, Birmingham and Manchester while stocks lasted, and a limited-edition 34-track GTAVI vinyl, featuring artists including Travis Scott, Cardi B, PinkPantheress and Fred Again, is due on 19 November.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI pre-load
items.note: Pre-load opened today ahead of the 19 Nov launch; the most pre-ordered game in PlayStation Store history.
items.read: On 10 November 2026, PlayStation's blog said Grand Theft Auto VI is now the most pre-ordered game in PlayStation Store history and that pre-loading on PS5 had opened that day, nine days before launch. Players with a code-in-box copy can also redeem the code and start the download as soon as they have it. Launch is a rolling midnight by country, beginning at 12:00 AM NZDT in New Zealand on 19 November. The post highlights DualSense speakers, haptics and adaptive triggers, Tempest 3D Audio and fast SSD load times, and says PS5 Pro adds improved clarity through PSSR and ray-traced shadows.
facts: most pre-ordered game in PlayStation Store history

items.title: GTA VI on PS5 Pro: PSSR and 30fps
items.note: Trending in Saudi and worldwide after Rockstar confirmed 30fps on all consoles, plus PSSR and ray-traced shadows on Pro.
items.read: The Verge reported on 10 November 2026 that Rockstar has confirmed a 30 FPS target for Grand Theft Auto VI on all consoles, including PS5 Pro. PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution and ray-traced shadows are exclusive to the PS5 Pro version. The story was published as pre-loads of more than 200 GB began, and it also notes Xbox Cloud Gaming support that will let the game stream to Xbox One. DualSense haptics, Tempest audio and faster load times are cited among the reasons PlayStation says the game "plays best" on PS5 consoles.

items.title: GTA VI on Xbox Cloud Gaming
items.note: Streams on day one, even on Xbox One.
items.read: Xbox Wire said on 10 November 2026 that Grand Theft Auto VI is the most pre-ordered title of all time on the Microsoft Store and encouraged players to start pre-loading ahead of the 19 November launch. The game will be playable on day one through Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S, starting at 1am ET, and cloud streams use Xbox Series S graphics settings. Series X and Series S can also play it natively, with pre-install already available, while Xbox One plays it only by streaming. In supported markets, cloud playtime without a Game Pass subscription can be bought from 11 November; the game itself is sold separately. More Rockstar titles, including GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2, are due on Cloud Gaming in the following months.
facts: Xbox One and Series X|S, using Series S settings
most pre-ordered title on the Microsoft Store

items.title: Adobe Firefly and Premiere mobile
items.note: More Firefly AI tools, plus licensed UMG and WMG tracks in Premiere mobile on iPhone.
items.read: Adobe's 10 November 2026 blog post expands Firefly, its AI creative studio, with tools to turn clips into vlogs, build campaign designs, retouch photos and run ready-made Quick Actions. A Creative Agent can help brainstorm and pick models, while always-on background agents are slated for a beta in early 2027. Premiere mobile on iPhone now includes hundreds of thousands of licensed Universal Music Group and Warner Music Group tracks for personal, non-commercial videos, with artists such as Olivia Dean and Noah Kahan mentioned, and Android support said to be coming soon. An AI Assistant with Quick Cut, which drafts an editable first cut from camera-roll footage, is opening as a private beta on Premiere mobile. New Firefly features are in beta except for generally available Quick Actions.
facts: Premiere mobile for iPhone, Android coming soon
Universal Music Group and Warner Music Group

items.title: Beit Kull Cafe, Olaya
items.note: Cairo-inspired vintage café facing Faisaliah Tower, classic Arabic music and manakish. 4.5 from 858 reviews.
items.read: Beit Kull Cafe sits on Olaya Street in Riyadh, just south of Faisaliah Tower, and is designed as a 1950s Cairo-style vintage café. LIST magazine reports that the furniture was brought from Cairo, the soundtrack leans on classic Arabic singers such as Umm Kulthum and Abdel Halim Hafez, and the food focus is oven-fresh manakish, with coffee, juices, mojitos and shisha alongside. The main salon is the highlight, with extra outdoor and contemporary rooms and space for up to 100 guests; Faisaliah Centre metro station is about a five-minute walk. Listed hours are 10am to 2:30am on weekdays and 4pm to 3:30am on weekends, and the phone number is +966 50 877 8114. The Google Maps rating quoted on the dashboard was not independently confirmed from the Maps page itself.
facts: Olaya St, Riyadh 12211, near Faisaliah Tower

items.title: Koojeh, Al Narjis
items.note: Charcoal Persian grill, kubideh and saffron joojeh at modest prices. 4.4 from 454 reviews.
items.read: Koojeh is a charcoal Persian grill in Riyadh, known for kubideh — ground lamb mixed only with onion and salt — and for joojeh chicken marinated for 48 hours in iqt (dried yoghurt) and saffron. Owner Ahmed Aldhubaib has described it as an intimate, accessible room rather than a formal fine-dining temple, and SceneNow reported that a second location was already open by mid-2025. An Arab News review found mains reasonably priced at SAR 47 to 74, praised the saffron ice cream, and scored the meal 8/10, while noting small rice portions and a compact menu. Gault&Millau later listed a related Koojeh site in Al Muruj at about SAR 80 to 100 a person, but the specific Al Narjis pin, hours and Google rating from the dashboard were not independently confirmed from Maps.

items.title: Dough Mate, Al Qirawan
items.note: Independent bakery: butter-rich croissants, fruit tarts, sourdough. 4.5 from 477 reviews.
items.read: Dough Mate (also written DoughMate) is an independent bakery and cakery in Al Qirawan, Riyadh, with a listed phone number of +966 50 899 1415 and hours of 8am to 11pm on a local review listing. Arab News described it as a brunch bakery that uses 82-percent-fat Elle & Vire butter, and named a date croissant as one of its bestsellers, alongside custard New York rolls, fruit-topped danishes, almond mini-croissants and mixed pastry boxes. Customer reviews of the Al Qirawan shop repeatedly praise the butter croissants, cakes and fruit tarts, though a few call prices high or cakes inconsistent. The 4.5 rating from 477 Google reviews quoted on the dashboard was not independently confirmed from the Maps page itself.
facts: butter croissants, date croissant, fruit tarts and danishes

items.title: Salwa Bookstore, King Abdullah Rd
items.note: Independent new and used books, swaps, and a free stack for anyone who can't pay. 4.5 from 1,173 reviews.
items.read: Salwa Bookstore is a small independent shop for new and used books at 2413 King Abdullah Road, Salah al-Din, Riyadh 12434. A local listing gives hours of 9am to midnight most days, and 4pm to midnight on Friday, with the phone number +966 55 595 1987 and website salwabookstore.com. Reviewers describe Arabic and English titles, a small reading corner, a book-exchange kiosk, and a free stack or shelf of books for people to take, including donated titles. Opinions on used-book prices are mixed, with some visitors calling them fair and others saying they can be high. The 4.5 rating from 1,173 Google reviews quoted on the dashboard was not independently confirmed from the Maps page itself.
facts: 2413 King Abdullah Rd, Salah al-Din, Riyadh 12434
new and used books, plus a free/exchange stack

items.title: New Anarkali Indian Restaurant, Al Wurud
items.note: Tamil Nadu-style dosa, idli, parotta and thali at fair prices. 4.4 from about 1,460 reviews.
items.read: New Anarkali Indian Restaurant is a South Indian, Tamil Nadu-style spot at Engineer, Al Anjari Street, Al Wurud, Riyadh 12251. Wanderlog, citing Google, listed a 4.4 rating from 1,517 reviews, with diners highlighting dosas, vegetable sambar, flaky parotta and other Southern dishes, plus combo meals. Hours are listed daily from 6am to midnight, and the phone number is +966 50 268 3836. Reviews also mention friendly service and generally fair prices, with a minority warning about extra charges on the bill.
facts: Engineer, Al Anjari Street, Al Wurud, Riyadh 12251

items.title: LocalSend
items.note: Free, open-source AirDrop-style sharing across iPhone, Android, Windows, Mac and Linux. No account, no cloud.
items.read: LocalSend is a free, open-source app for sending files between nearby devices over the local network, with no account, login or internet required. The official site says it runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS, uses end-to-end encryption over HTTPS, and can add optional PIN verification. Transfers use the speed of the local Wi-Fi, with no cloud hop and no ads or trackers; files land in the Downloads folder by default. The homepage cites more than 93,000 GitHub stars, 35 million downloads and 230 contributors.

items.title: Yamama Super Office
items.note: Saudi-built, Arabic-first office suite with proper RTL, Hijri dates and Office import. Free to start, Pro SAR 29 per 30 days.
items.read: Yamama Super Office is a browser-based office suite with Docs, Sheets, Slides, Mail, Calendar and an AI assistant, designed Arabic-first with proper right-to-left text and both Hijri and Gregorian dates, shown in Riyadh time. It opens and exports Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, and the interface can switch between Arabic and English. The apps themselves are free; AI features run on points, with 10 points before sign-up, 50 after sign-up, 2,000 points on Pro and 10,000 on Business. Pro is SAR 29 per 30 days and Business is SAR 99 per 30 days, with no card required to start, and optional Windows and Android apps are also mentioned.
facts: all apps, no card needed to start

items.title: Organic Maps
items.note: Free, ad-free, tracker-free offline maps and navigation on OpenStreetMap.
items.read: Organic Maps is a free, open-source offline maps and navigation app built on OpenStreetMap, with no ads, tracking or required registration. After maps are downloaded it can search, plan multi-stop routes, record GPS tracks and give turn-by-turn walking, cycling and driving directions, including voice guidance, CarPlay and Android Auto, plus public-transport routing. Outdoor features include hiking and cycling layers, contour lines, elevation profiles and an Outdoors map style for trails and huts. The project, made by people from the old MapsWithMe/MAPS.ME team, said in October 2026 that it had passed 12 million installs.
facts: walk, bike, drive, public transport; CarPlay and Android Auto

items.title: BentoPDF
items.note: Merge, split, compress and sign PDFs in the browser. No signup, no watermark, no uploads.
items.read: BentoPDF is a free, browser-based PDF toolkit that processes files locally on the device, with no uploads, no sign-up and no watermarks. The site lists more than 100 tools, including merge, split, compress, in-browser signing, editing, OCR, form filling and digital signatures. It says it uses no cookies or analytics and claims GDPR, CCPA and HIPAA-oriented privacy because files never leave the computer. It runs in a modern browser on Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS and Android, and use is described as unlimited and free.
facts: local in the browser, no uploads
100-plus, including merge, split, compress and sign
